data.contentEn:
Musinsa Co., Ltd.
Notice of Setting the Shareholder Registry Reference Date for the Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders

‍

Pursuant to Article 354 of the Commercial Act and Article 16 of our Articles of Incorporation, we hereby announce the following date for determining shareholders entitled to attend the extraordinary general meeting of shareholders.

‍

- under -

Shareholder registry confirmation date: Thursday, August 8, 2024
Early Shareholders' Meeting Scheduled Date: 9:00 AM, Monday, September 9, 2024

‍

July 23, 2024

Musinsa Co., Ltd.
11, Achasan-ro 13-gil, 1st floor, Seongdong-gu, Seoul (Seongsu-dong 2-ga, Musinsa Campus N1)
CEO Cho Man-ho

Korea Securities Depository, the transfer agent
